summary: "Swift Path to The Realm of Bliss" is a two-session Pure Land Buddhism teaching series held at Urban Dharma, the West Asheville Buddhist temple, free and open to all levels. It is listed under the temple's own "Special Events" section alongside its "Regular Events" (Morning Sit, Recovery Dharma, sangha gatherings) rather than run by an outside business, taught either by the temple's resident teacher or a visiting teacher in the temple's own hall.

evidence.note: Both listings are at 697 Haywood Rd (Urban Dharma's own address), free, tagged Pure Land Buddhism / Dharma Talk / Bodhisattva Training / All Levels Welcome.
The event's own canonical URL sits under Urban Dharma's /special-events/ path, i.e. it is the temple's own programming, not a third-party listing.

Urban Dharma describes itself as "A Buddhist Temple in the Heart of West Asheville" with a site split into Regular Events and Special Events, plus a newsletter for ongoing engagement, consistent with an established sangha rather than a drop-in class vendor.

The temple's Special Events (Tara Empowerment, Buddha Day, Dharma Hall Inauguration, etc.) are taught by the temple's own teacher, Dr. Lye, or visiting Rinpoches, and combine community continuity with public accessibility - the same model as this teaching series.

No separate website, Facebook group, or Meetup page exists for this specific 2-session teaching series; it is entirely a program of Urban Dharma itself, the same sangha already classified as a group for its other series.
